profile_metadata.format_family: TYPE-MOON smash framework + fzmedia media library

conditions: main executable import directory references a DLL whose name starts with null-ge- and imports a symbol containing IGameEngine@fw@smash@@
a loaded module whose name starts with fzmedia- exports every prefix in required_fzmedia_export_prefixes
x64 process (the x86 build compiles an inert stub: probe=false, lookup admission EngineUnsupported)
admission.identity_cache: tri-state (unknown / accepted / rejected); unknown never takes an irreversible decision and is re-probed every 500 ms

measured_sample.title: Fate/stay night REMASTERED

audio.resource_container: FCD ('FCD\0', u16be version, u16be flags bit0 = encrypted, u32be header size); fzmedia decrypts in place on its file thread before play
audio.capture: SoundObject::play detour: category 5 and isReady -> convertToRawFile(this, shared_ptr<vector<uint8_t>>) -> complete Ogg Vorbis file (OggS, observed 25-95 KB, <= 1 MiB enforced) copied into an 8 x 1 MiB bounded slot ring
audio.pairing: resource precedes text by ~70-80 ms; ResolveFollowingSelectedText with a 1500 ms window; same id deduplicated within 2000 ms

text.layer_units: design pixels, uniform aspect-fit into the client area, centred
anchor_derivation_chain: x64 CompleteObjectLocator {signature=1, offset=0, pTypeDescriptor=TD rva, pSelf=own rva} (unique)
vtable = the slot after the unique pointer to that COL
constructor = the unique function containing lea rax,[rip+vtable]; mov [rsi],rax
mesh build = the unique function with >= 5 direct E8 calls to the constructor
layoutChar = the unique function containing mov rax,[rdx+d]; movzx r10d,word [rax+r8*2] and exactly one direct call to mesh build

field offsets decoded from layoutChar bytes: text_begin/text_end (r15+e / r15+b with e == b + 8), cursor_x (addss/movss same disp), cursor_y (= cursor_x + 4, followed by movd xmm0,[rdi+line_pitch]), font_px (mulss xmm8), scale (movss/mulss xmm0 same disp)
text.retry: anchor scan retried every 500 ms for up to 120 s (SteamStub unpacks .text after entry) and immediately whenever install() re-enters
text.paragraph_assembly: runs merged while the CJK quote balance (「」『』（）) is open, 2500 ms continuation window, single-space wait-cursor run ignored, same-run re-layout is idempotent
